ideas.title: The Feeding Our Future Scandal: A Deep Dive into Minnesota's Largest Fraud Case
ideas.description: This story would investigate the details of the $250M Feeding Our Future scheme, including the mastermind behind it and the impact on Minnesota's social services.
questions: What was the extent of the scheme?
How did it go undetected for so long?
ideas.insight: This story matters because it highlights the need for greater oversight and accountability in social services programs.

ideas.title: The Rise of Medicaid Fraud in Minnesota: A Growing Concern
ideas.description: This story would explore the growing concern of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota, including the $46.6M scheme announced by Robert F. Kennedy Jr.
questions: What are the common tactics used by fraudsters?
How can we prevent such schemes in the future?
ideas.insight: This story matters because it highlights the need for better data analysis and detection methods to prevent Medicaid fraud.
